breakdown.description: The sinusoidal right-edge traction is evaluated with x on the boundary x = 1 instead of with the specified vertical coordinate
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly applies the sinusoidal traction as t = (0, -6000·sin(4π·x[1])) Pa, explicitly noting that x[1] is the vertical coordinate y. This matches the ground truth which specifies σ_yy = -6000*sin(4πy), using the vertical coordinate y. The agent did not repeat the error from the incomplete prompt that incorrectly instructed using the x coordinate on the boundary x=1.
